$comment: Game repository for מאה בקליק. It declares which game templates exist and exactly what data shape each one needs; templates are static and tested once, and generation produces only a data file per assignment. NOTE: the `selection` block below is ADVISORY — nothing reads it. See its own comment.

selection.$comment: Matching rules, most specific first. ENFORCED as prompt text since 2026-09-25: gameSelectionLines() in src/lib/server/lesson/prep.ts renders these rules, in this order, into the generation prompt, and tests/unit/lesson-teaching-rules.test.mjs fails if a rule names a game the plan schema cannot produce. The model still decides which rules match the lesson; the rules are what it is told to decide by. Before that date nothing read this block (3 of 4 repeated briefs came back with a different game set) — see docs/quality/game-standard.md.

rules.when: a worked solution the student can follow but not justify — find the faulty step
a concept students routinely get wrong — surface the misconception
build fluency and speed on rules already understood
connect a function to its graph, or a graph to its derivative
place values on a number line — fractions, decimals, negatives
memorise terms, vocabulary, formulas — 6 to 16 items
term to definition, symbol to meaning, Hebrew to English, rule to example
order the steps of a process or a worked solution
label parts of a diagram, graph, or figure
compare several things across several criteria
check understanding with mixed question types

conventions.reporting: Every template POSTs its result to /api/game-result on completion: { dataId, student, template, score, total, durationSec, missed: [] }. Stored in SQLite (server/db.mjs); if that write fails the request still returns ok, since a storage hiccup must never make a finished game look broken to the student.
conventions.reuse: Data files are keyed by topic, not by student. Two students on the same topic share one data file; only the URL's student parameter differs.
conventions.styling: All templates use the site palette: bg #F8FAFC, text #1E293B, brand #2563EB, CTA #FA8231, success #10B981 (fills only, #047857 for green text). RTL, Heebo, min 44px touch targets, works from 380px wide.
